config.notes: SCU course pages (www.scu.edu.au/study/courses/<slug>-<code>/) print two snapshot panels: Domestic first, International second (domestic-only courses print one). Each has Start Date (month names), Duration, Location, Language Requirements (IELTS Overall Score), Course code, Indicative fee ($X (first year only); domestic adds Commonwealth supported / Fee Paying). Intakes and IELTS are read only from a panel whose Indicative fee is the international one (no Commonwealth/Fee Paying), last match; fee = international indicative first-year fee (= Annual Fees in the availability table). Handbook pages (handbook.scu.edu.au/.../<year>) are archived years with no intakes/fees. term_months from SCU 2026 teaching dates PDF https://www.scu.edu.au/media/scu-dep/staff/governance-and-records/academic-board/principal-dates/SCU-2026-Teaching-Dates---Terms.pdf (Summer Jan, T1 Mar, T2 May, T3 Jul, T4 Aug, T5 Oct). English central: https://www.scu.edu.au/study/international-study/how-to-apply-international-future-students/english-language-requirements/
